question: Does a highly efficient eight-segment US100 M15 close path, defined as large signed displacement relative to total absolute log-return travel, produce a sufficiently frequent and double-spread-positive one-market-hour continuation or reversion response to justify exactly one later standalone additive entry-prototype question that must subsequently face the whole six-strategy portfolio?

predeclaration_history_feasibility.purpose: Use only full-year or full-YTD 2024+ intervals whose already-preserved independent logs support feasibility, while requiring every new Unit 033 path to repeat the complete integrity gate.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.source: Already-preserved cumulative Unit 030 agent-log suffixes and HTML model labels only; no Unit 030 or Unit 032 opportunity economics are used.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.unit_032_split_path_caveat: Unit 032's separately executed 2024 H1 path reported 99 percent and is closed invalid. Unit 033 neither reuses nor repairs that split path; its fresh full-2024 path must independently pass both required gates.
predeclaration_history_feasibility.excluded_interval: 2022-08-01 through 2024-01-01 remains outside Unit 033 because preserved detailed Tester evidence used generated replacement ticks there.

fixed_observer.evaluation_clock: At the first valid executable tick of each newly opened US100 M15 bar, inspect only eight log-return segments ending at the immediately completed bar.
fixed_observer.valid_tick: Bid and ask are positive and ask is not below bid; executable mid is their arithmetic mean.
fixed_observer.continuous_history: The current bar and all nine completed close observations needed for eight returns must have exactly 900 seconds between every adjacent bar time. Session reopen and every other discontinuous boundary are excluded.
fixed_observer.return_definition: For completed closes k=1 through 8, natural log of close[k] divided by close[k+1].
fixed_observer.signed_displacement: Sum of all eight log returns, equal to log of the latest completed close divided by the oldest completed close.
fixed_observer.travel_length: Sum of the absolute values of all eight log returns.
fixed_observer.path_efficiency: Absolute signed displacement divided by travel length.
fixed_observer.trigger: While no observation is unresolved, trigger at the first valid tick of the new M15 bar when at least six returns are nonzero, travel length is positive, signed displacement is nonzero and path efficiency is at least 0.70.
fixed_observer.continuation_direction: BUY when signed displacement is positive and SELL when it is negative.
fixed_observer.horizon: Resolve at the first valid executable tick after four subsequent US100 M15 market-bar advances, equal to one market hour without counting closed-market time.
fixed_observer.overlap: At most one unresolved observation. No candidate is evaluated while an observation remains active; a new candidate may be evaluated at the same boundary immediately after resolution.
fixed_observer.entry_prices: At trigger use current ask for BUY and current bid for SELL.
fixed_observer.exit_prices: At resolution use current bid for BUY and current ask for SELL.
fixed_observer.observed_cost_profit: Use OrderCalcProfit at 0.01 volume with actual trigger and resolution bid/ask prices.
fixed_observer.double_spread_profit: Apply one additional trigger spread and one additional resolution spread against each direction, then call OrderCalcProfit. This is the only cost stress.
fixed_observer.eligible_path_day: A distinct server date containing at least one idle continuous evaluation with positive travel length, nonzero signed displacement and at least six nonzero returns.
outputs: one row per resolved trigger with window end and entry times, nonzero-return count, signed displacement, travel length, path efficiency, directions, entry/exit bid/ask, spreads, market bars held and observed/double-spread continuation/reversion USD
one summary row with eligible path days/evaluations, finalized bars, valid ticks, triggers, resolved, unresolved and rate/tick/profit-calculation faults
start and end US100 visible contract-spec snapshots

tester_contract.model: Every tick based on real ticks

environment_contract.origin: One minimal physical pre-run copy of build-6140 generic Lab executables and cached US100 history/ticks into the short family runtime; no Live or other-family runtime link.
environment_contract.required_raw_tick_scope: US100 monthly real-tick files 2024-01 through 2026-07 inclusive. The invalid 2022-2023 interval and incomplete 2026-08 month are outside every fixed path and outside the invariant.
pre_outcome_freeze: source, SET, INI and EX5 manifests
required copied US100 monthly real-tick file manifests for 2024-01 through 2026-07
visible US100 digits, point, tick size/value, contract size, volume minimum/step and stops/freeze levels
per_path_gate: HTML report labels the path 100 percent real ticks and Tester stops normally.
The path-specific newly appended detailed agent-log segment contains zero absent-real-tick, discarded-real-tick, volume-mismatch, price-mismatch or every-tick-generation-used telemetry.
Required 2024-01 through 2026-07 US100 real-tick file hashes remain unchanged.
Observer start/end visible contract specifications are equal to the frozen values.
rate, invalid-tick and OrderCalcProfit faults are zero.
resolved output rows equal the summary resolved count and unresolved is at most one.
environment_contract.database_housekeeping: Generic selected-symbol, symbols database, current incomplete-month tick or derived history-cache changes alone are telemetry, not invalidation, because none is an economically consumed fixed-path raw-tick invariant.
environment_contract.single_rebuild_allowance: If a required in-scope monthly tick hash or visible specification changes before any semantic output is read, discard the path unread, rebuild the dedicated runtime once from the frozen generic Lab cache and rerun the identical path. A second change closes the unit invalid without economic judgment. HTML below 100 percent or detailed generation telemetry is not a rebuild condition and closes invalid immediately.

path_metrics: eligible path days/evaluations, resolved opportunities and opportunities per eligible path day
observed-cost net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
double-spread net, wins, losses, profit factor and maximum closed drawdown
fixed_aggregation.pooled_metrics: Concatenate the three ordered path books without compounding volume and calculate the same metrics plus path contribution shares.
fixed_aggregation.zero_profit: Neither win nor loss and excluded from profit-factor numerator and denominator while retained in opportunity count.

fixed_selection_gate.integrity: All three paths pass the environment and observer contracts.
frequency: At least 0.75 resolved opportunities per eligible path day pooled.
At least 0.50 resolved opportunities per eligible path day in at least two of three paths.
economic: One direction book has positive pooled double-spread net USD.
Its pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
Its double-spread net is positive in at least two of three paths.
Its pooled double-spread net divided by pooled maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50.
No one path contributes more than 75 percent of the direction's total positive-path double-spread profit.
fixed_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by higher pooled double-spread net, then higher profit factor, then more positive paths, then lexicographic direction name.
fixed_selection_gate.passing_action: Retain exactly one later standalone additive US100 entry-prototype question for the selected direction. Unit 033 places no trade and selects no stop, hold extension, size above 0.01, portfolio priority or Live candidate. A later prototype must be identity-separated and a subsequent combination unit must retain and evaluate all six existing strategies with their opportunity count unchanged.
fixed_selection_gate.failure_action: Close with no directional-path-efficiency prototype question. Do not rescue with another segment count, nonzero-return minimum, efficiency threshold, displacement or travel transform, price basis, bar period, continuity rule, overlap rule, horizon, direction subgroup, spread stress or period exception.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before adding source, configuration or reading any outcome.
Before any MQL change, reread the authoritative source-topology discipline and current Lab baseline declaration.
Compile corrections are allowed before any Tester path; freeze the first 0-error, 0-warning source and do not tune from compilation telemetry.
Commit and push source, configuration and compile receipt before the first path.
Run exactly three serial paths, subject only to the one environment rebuild allowance.
Do not inspect partial economic output between paths except integrity and normal-stop telemetry required to decide whether the next frozen path may run.
Do not query, alter, stop or restart Live.
